children: Axon Enterprise completed a multi-part financing, issuing $1.15 billion of 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 under a new indenture, supported by an Underwriting Agreement that included a fully exercised $150 million over-allotment. The company also purchased capped calls for about $114.9 million, initially capped at $1,049.94 per share, to mitigate dilution and potential cash outlays upon conversion. In connection with the offering, Axon amended its JPMorgan-led credit agreement to align terms with the new notes. Proceeds will fund the capped calls and general corporate purposes, supporting growth initiatives.
Agreement 1: Axon Enterprise Issues $1.15 Billion 0% Convertible Notes Due 2031 Under New Indenture
: Indenture for 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031
: U.S. Bank Trust Company, as trustee
: Raise capital for growth and general purposes
Agreement 2: Axon Enterprise Enters Underwriting Agreement for $1.15 Billion Convertible Notes Offering
: Underwriting agreement for public offering of convertible notes
: Facilitate public issuance of convertible notes
Agreement 3: Axon Enterprise Buys Capped Calls at $1,049.94 Cap, Spending $114.9 Million to Limit Dilution
: Capped call transactions related to convertible notes
: Through notes maturity, subject to terms
: Reduce dilution and offset cash outlays on conversion
Agreement 4: Axon Enterprise Amends JPMorgan-Led Credit Agreement Following Notes Offering
: Second amendment to revolving credit agreement
: JPMorgan Chase Bank, as administrative agent, and lenders
: Align facility terms with convertible notes issuance
